request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: How often must the Effer truck-mounted hydraulic crane at position 7 of the IGEA list, built in 2017, be verified?

response.text: {"kind": "text", "value": "Annual (verifica annuale), per Allegato VII, riga 12 of D.Lgs. 81/08, because the crane is mobile and used in the extractive (mining) sector. The 2017 build year would only give a biennial cadence under riga 13 if the use were regular and the sector did not apply.", "text": "The Effer 790 (position 7, built 2017, truck-mounted hydraulic crane) must be verified annually. The IGEA schedule (igea-equipment.md, Allegato A, Tabella A1, and Allegato B) defers the cadence to Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/08, and Allegato VII riga 12 sets an annual verification for mobile lifting equipment over 200 kg used in extractive sectors. Allegato B lists this crane under 'Area mineraria'. The 2017 build year would only point to a biennial cadence under riga 13 (fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni, utilizzo regolare), which does not apply to this mining-sector use.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 12", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo mobile o trasferibile, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo | Verifica annuale"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 13", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo mobile o trasferibile, con modalità di utilizzo regolare e anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifica biennale"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "## p. 8", "quote": "Area mineraria Iglesias Campo Pisano AUTOCARRO GRU IDRAULICA 2018/20004 IVECO Area mineraria 7 Effer 790 2017 100026789 Iglesias PER 5/CA FIAT Campo Pisano"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "## p. 3", "quote": "Per tutte e 24 le posizioni in oggetto, la verifica è da considerarsi secondo le cadenze previste dall’Allegato VII del D.Lgs. 81/08;"}]}
